cost_gate: Compare incremental component, feeder, placement, soldering, inspection, handling and procurement costs at actual batch quantities
Prefer existing JLC SMT process and few shared MPNs; no assumed free manual labor or automatic PCB cost saving
No custom tooling or process escalation without showing the total cost tradeoff to the owner
physical_gate: Flat SMT bars save width via conductor cross-section but do not grant clearance to route under their conductive underside
Raised THT bars require explicit stand-off, hole/tab, solder-joint and opposing-board clearance qualification
No bar may bypass a shunt, protection component or Kelvin partition
Verify full-current entrances, exits and intervening PCB necks; bar cross-section alone is not an ampacity rating
Use actual material, attachment and cooling boundaries in electrical/thermal models; no invented conductivity or contact performance
